Frequently Asked Questions

How many yards of concrete for a 18x21 Double Metal Carport Concrete Slab Calculator?

A 18' × 21' pour at 4 inches thick with a 12" thickened perimeter edge requires 7.25 cubic yards including 10% waste (327 bags of 80 lb concrete).

What PSI concrete should I order for 18x21 Double Metal Carport Concrete Slab Calculator?

We recommend 3500 PSI structural concrete (air-entrained in freeze-thaw zones) reinforced with #4 rebar on 18-inch centers (32 × 20-ft sticks) over 7.52 tons of compacted #57 stone.
